sections.title: 一、完形填空
sections.instruction: 阅读短文，从各题所给的四个选项中选出可以填入空白处的最佳选项。
sections.passage:
From a security guard (保安) to a lawyer, Liu Zheng is a great example who can make dreams come true by working hard.

Liu, 33, grew up in a small [1] in Hebei Province. After finishing school in 2015, he took a job as a security guard at Peking University. However, he had a bigger dream-to be a lawyer one day, [2] he worked hard to follow his dream.

In 2016, he started studying for the law exam. He worked from 5 p.m. to midnight. The next morning, he still got up [3] to audit (旁听) law courses.

The teachers and students were very kind to him. Many teachers gave him the latest textbooks (最新教材) and [4] him to audit their courses. One teacher, Zhang Shuanggen, once gave Liu a textbook. In it he wrote, "May you become a [5] lawyer." Some students shared their notes with him. With their help, Liu studied [6] by himself and took the exam. He failed six times but he never [7] Finally, he passed in 2022. In 2025, he [8] the university and began working at a top law firm (顶级律所) in Beijing.

Liu's story [9] many people. A student from Peking University says, "I often see Liu in the self-study rooms. Even though we don't [10] each other, he teaches me that with hard work, even the biggest dream can come true."

questions.translation: Liu 33岁，在河北省的一个小村庄长大。
questions.explanation: 根据常识与后文他去北京大学当保安可知，他出生在河北的一个小村庄（village）。故选 village。

questions.translation: 然而，他有一个更大的梦想——将来成为一名律师，所以他努力去追逐自己的梦想。
questions.explanation: 前后句为因果关系，因为有梦想所以努力追梦，用连词 so 连接。故选 so。

questions.translation: 第二天早上，他仍然很早起床去旁听法律课程。
questions.explanation: 根据前文提到他工作到半夜（midnight），第二天早上仍然很早（early）起床去旁听课程。故选 early。

questions.translation: 许多老师给他最新的教材，并邀请他旁听他们的课程。
questions.explanation: 老师们非常友善，邀请（invited）他去旁听课程。故选 invited。

questions.translation: 在书中他写道：“愿你成为一名自信的律师。”
questions.explanation: 老师鼓励他成为一名自信的（confident）律师。故选 confident。

questions.translation: 在他们的帮助下，Liu 自学了法律并参加了考试。
questions.explanation: 根据前文提到他想成为律师（lawyer）并旁听法律课，因此他自学的是法律（law）。故选 law。

questions.translation: 他失败了六次，但他从未放弃。
questions.explanation: 根据后文提到他最终通过了考试，说明他虽然失败了六次但从不放弃（give up）。故选 gave up。

questions.translation: 2025年，他离开了大学，开始在北京的一家顶级律所工作。
questions.explanation: 通过考试后，他离开（left）了大学保安的岗位，进入律所工作。故选 left。

questions.translation: Liu 的故事感动了许多人。
questions.explanation: 通过坚持不懈实现梦想的励志故事感动（moved）了很多人。故选 moved。

questions.translation: 即使我们彼此不相识，他也教会了我通过努力工作，即使是最大的梦想也能成真。
questions.explanation: 根据句意，虽然大家互不相识（know each other），但他勤奋的身影激励了他人。故选 know。

sections.title: 二、阅读理解
sections.instruction: 阅读短文，从各题所给的四个选项中选出最佳选项。
sections.passage:
Meng Xiang was crazy about films and music during his childhood. When he started college, he dreamed of making films that could combine (结合) his love for storytelling and interest in music.

His biggest challenge came when he planned to make a film about a tennis player. As no one would offer him money for a 2-hour film, Meng and his college friends tried to make a shorter one. They bought a second-hand camera and used old things instead of expensive equipment (设备). They even made a shelf on their own to support the camera.

Meng and his friends worked hard, rain or shine. When filming the tennis player, they ran after him in the summer sun. If it rained and they couldn't film outside, they hung bed sheets (床单) on the walls in an empty room to set up a simple studio (摄影棚). This 12-minute film got much attention. The teachers and students in their college liked the music they created. After that, Meng had another idea: to make a musical film. But musicals weren't popular in college, and many said it wouldn't work. Instead of listening to the doubts(怀疑), Meng and his team spent weeks writing new songs and making a test video. To film the moving scenes, they fixed(固定) a smartphone on a skateboard and pushed it. The actors' hair was blowing in the wind while they were dancing and singing. The loud voice and laughter of the team filled the air.

Their musical film became a hit and won several awards at a film festival. As Meng said, "Making films isn't about having the best equipment or famous actors. It's about finding new ways to tell your story. Our team is planning to make a special documentary about the environment. And I can't wait to write music for it."

questions.prompt: How would Meng combine his hobbies according to paragraph 1?
questions.translation: 根据第1段，Meng 如何结合他的爱好？
questions.explanation: 根据第1段 'he dreamed of making films that could combine (结合) his love for storytelling and interest in music.' 可知，他通过制作电影（producing films）来结合讲故事和音乐这两大爱好。故选 By producing films。

questions.prompt: What was the team's biggest challenge?
questions.translation: 团队面临的最大挑战是什么？
questions.explanation: 根据第2段 'His biggest challenge came when he planned to make a film about a tennis player. As no one would offer him money for a 2-hour film...' 可知，没有资金支持是最大的挑战。故选 The money problem。

questions.prompt: Why did Meng's team set up a simple studio?
questions.translation: Meng 的团队为什么搭建一个简易摄影棚？
questions.explanation: 根据第3段 'If it rained and they couldn't film outside, they hung bed sheets on the walls in an empty room to set up a simple studio.' 可知是为了在下雨天无法进行室外拍摄时继续工作。故选 To work on rainy days。

questions.prompt: What can be learned from the last sentence of paragraph 3?
options: Meng wanted to make another film.
questions.translation: 从第3段最后一句能了解到什么？
questions.explanation: 根据第3段最后一句 'The loud voice and laughter of the team filled the air.'（团队响亮的声音和欢笑声充满了空气）可知，团队成员非常享受拍摄的过程。故选 The team enjoyed the process。

questions.prompt: What would be the best title for the passage?
options: Hard Work Makes the Dream Work
questions.translation: 这篇文章的最佳标题是什么？
questions.explanation: 文章讲述了 Meng 和他的大学朋友们在设备和资金有限的情况下，通过勤奋努力、不断克服困难最终实现了电影梦想并获奖的故事。Hard Work Makes the Dream Work（努力付出让梦想成真）最能概括主旨。故选 Hard Work Makes the Dream Work。

sections.title: 三、阅读还原
sections.instruction: 阅读下面短文，从短文后的选项中选出可以填入空白处的最佳选项。有一项多余。
sections.passage:
# How to Make a Good Study Plan

Do you always feel there is too much homework and too little time? A good study plan can help you manage (管理) your time, reduce stress, and improve your grades. [1]

First, you need to know what you must do. [2] List all your subjects and the tasks for each, like homework, reviewing, and preparing for tests. Don't forget to include your regular activities, such as sports or music classes.

After listing everything, it's time to prioritize (划分优先顺序). [3] You can use labels like "very important" "important", and "not urgent" to decide which tasks to do first. This helps you focus on what really matters.

[4] Your plan should work for you, not against you. If you find you are more focused in the morning, plan your most difficult subjects for that time. If you are more focused at night, do the hard work in the evening.

Finally, remember that a plan can change. If you have a sudden school event, you can adjust your plan. The most important thing is to get started. A good plan is your first step towards success.
wordbank: This means deciding which tasks are the most important.
It is not a good idea to study for a long time without rest.
Start by writing down all your schoolwork and activities.
Everyone has their own most productive time of the day.
Here's some advice on how to create one.

questions.translation: 空格[1]填空
questions.explanation: 前文提到好学习计划的作用，此处承上启下引出下文关于如何制定学习计划的具体建议。故选 "Here's some advice on how to create one."。

questions.translation: 空格[2]填空
questions.explanation: 本段核心是明确自己必须做的事情，后文列举了作业、复习等，因此此处指先写下所有学业和活动。故选 "Start by writing down all your schoolwork and activities."。

questions.translation: 空格[3]填空
questions.explanation: 前句提到 'prioritize (划分优先顺序)'，该句解释 prioritize 的含义即决定哪些任务最重要。故选 "This means deciding which tasks are the most important."。

questions.translation: 空格[4]填空
questions.explanation: 后文根据早上或晚上哪个时段更专注来安排难易科目的学习，说明每个人一天中效率最高的时间不同。故选 "Everyone has their own most productive time of the day."。

sections.title: 四、语法填空
sections.instruction: 阅读下面短文，在空白处填入1个适当的单词或括号内单词的正确形式。
sections.passage:
As the new year began, I decided to make some resolutions. My first step was to write an introduction (介绍) to my goals in a notebook. I used different colors for each goal to make them clear. I wanted [1] (achieve) the following three things: get physically stronger, live more healthily, and become [2] (organized).

At first, the goals seemed [3] (possible). How could I possibly keep on [4] (take) exercise every day? I tried many times, but I always stopped after a few days. Later, I realized that planning [5] (wise) was the key. I needed specific (具体的) plans [6] I wanted to really get fit. So, I decided to run for 20 minutes every morning.

[7] first month was quite difficult. I almost [8] (fail) when I missed two days of running. I felt a little sad but decided not to give up. I reminded [9] (I) that progress isn't about perfection; it's about persistence (坚持).

After three months, I was able to see real progress. My clothes fit better, and I felt stronger. My biggest achievement was running 5 kilometers [10] stopping! This progress filled me with growing confidence. The journey also taught me that good plans need clear steps and persistence.

questions.translation: 我想实现以下三件事……
questions.explanation: want to do sth. 为固定搭配，表示“想要做某事”，后接动词不定式。故选 to achieve。

questions.translation: ……变得更有条理。
questions.explanation: 与前文的 'get physically stronger'（变得身体更强壮）、'live more healthily'（生活得更健康）并列，此处应用形容词比较级 more organized。故选 more organized。

questions.translation: 起初，这些目标似乎是不可能实现的。
questions.explanation: 根据后文 'How could I possibly keep on taking exercise every day?' 可知起初觉得目标不可能实现，应用否定前缀形容词 impossible。故选 impossible。

questions.translation: 我怎么可能坚持每天锻炼呢？
questions.explanation: keep on doing sth. 为固定搭配，表示“持续/坚持做某事”，介词 on 后接动名词形式。故选 taking。

questions.translation: 后来我意识到，明智地做计划是关键。
questions.explanation: 修饰动名词 planning 作状语，应用副词 wisely。故选 wisely。

questions.translation: 如果我想真正变强壮，我需要具体的计划。
questions.explanation: 引导条件状语从句，意为“如果”，应用从属连词 if。故选 if。

questions.translation: 第一个月相当困难。
questions.explanation: 序数词 first 前通常加定冠词 The，且位于句首首字母大写。故选 The。

questions.translation: 当我缺了跑两天的步时，我差点失败了。
questions.explanation: 根据上下文时态（was, missed, felt）可知此处描述过去发生的事情，用一般过去时 failed。故选 failed。

questions.translation: 我提醒自己，进步不在于完美，而在于坚持。
questions.explanation: 主语 I 和宾语指同一个人，宾语应用反身代词 myself（remind oneself 提醒自己）。故选 myself。

questions.translation: 我最大的成就是不间断地跑了5公里！
questions.explanation: 根据句意表示“中途没有停下来”，without stopping 表示“不停顿地”。故选 without。

sections.title: 五、任务型阅读
sections.instruction: 阅读下面短文，根据短文内容从各题所给的四个选项中选出最佳选项。
sections.passage:
As the saying goes, "If you fail to plan, you are planning to fail." Many people may think of planning as a boring thing, but it's actually one of the most useful skills we should learn. Planning means creating a timeline and a road map for achieving the goals we have set for ourselves.

In fact, we all plan in one way or another and enjoy the benefits (好处) of it in our daily lives, even if we don't realize it. A great example of this is when we plan our holidays. Planning helps us remember what to do and where to go before we leave. By planning ahead, we can enjoy a much better holiday experience.

Planning is also widely used for managing a personal budget. By making a spending plan, we can regularly check our finances (财力) and stop ourselves from wasting money on unnecessary things. This helps us save money and achieve both big dreams (like foreign travels) and small wishes (like weekly snacks).

For some people, planning has become an important part of life. Whether it's for studying, working, or achieving personal dreams, a good plan helps us use time wisely and avoid mistakes. Besides, having a plan enables us to deal with variables (易变的事), which can reduce stress compared to not having a plan at all.

Now you see why planning is so important! To get started, you can write down your goals, break them into easier-to-achieve parts, and then start planning how to make them come true. Little by little, your plans will turn your big dreams into real-life achievements!

questions.prompt: How does the writer start the passage?
questions.translation: 作者是如何开头这篇文章的？
questions.explanation: 根据第1段第一句 'As the saying goes, "If you fail to plan, you are planning to fail."' 可知，作者通过引用名言俗语开头。故选 By quoting a popular saying。

questions.prompt: What does planning mean according to the passage?
options: Creating a timeline and a road map for goals.
Completing all tasks without any help.
Spending extra money on unnecessary items.
questions.translation: 根据短文，做计划意味着什么？
questions.explanation: 根据第1段最后一句 'Planning means creating a timeline and a road map for achieving the goals we have set for ourselves.' 可知。故选 Creating a timeline and a road map for goals。

questions.prompt: What is the benefit of planning our holiday?
options: It helps us decide who to invite home.
It calculates how much money we saved.
It helps us remember what to do and where to go.
It encourages us to take fewer vacations.
questions.translation: 为假期做计划的好处是什么？
questions.explanation: 根据第2段 'Planning helps us remember what to do and where to go before we leave.' 可知。故选 It helps us remember what to do and where to go。

questions.prompt: Which word in the passage means "避免"?
questions.translation: 文章中哪个单词的意思是“避免”？
questions.explanation: 第4段中 'a good plan helps us use time wisely and avoid mistakes.' 中的 avoid 意为“避免”。故选 avoid。

questions.prompt: What does the writer think of planning?
options: One of the most useful skills to learn.
A completely boring routine to follow.
A task only adults should worry about.
A difficult and useless habit for students.
questions.translation: 作者对做计划怎么看？
questions.explanation: 根据第1段 '...it's actually one of the most useful skills we should learn.' 可知作者认为计划是最有用的技能之一。故选 One of the most useful skills to learn。
